Tagtreevivor S3: Phantom Plunder
Spectator-Games / johnathans-rock-expo
JerryThe 1/17/2025 2:03 PM
Hey there, ye scurvy dogs! It's your good pal Johnathan, here to tell you about the new Rockvivor thing we're going to be running! (edited)
2:04 PM
2:04 PM
Hey there, ye scurvy dogs! It's your good pal Johnathan, here to tell you about the new Rockvivor thing we're going to be running! Before every episode, each of you will be assigned a player at random. There will be some advantages that you may gain access that will change the randomness of this assignment. For these, you will compete in small occasional challenges. If your person's tribe goes to tribal, you will too! At this point, you will be pulled into a thread and publicly vote on who you want to go home. Each vote adds a rock to a sack. The player that gets voted out in the game will have an additional rock added to the sack to the person they are assigned. We will then be removing the rocks one at a time until there is only one left, or one name left. Whoever has the last rock, loses, and must mosey their way down the plank. But hold on to your bumflaps, there's a little more. Anytime that your player becomes immune, you will too! Whoever holds out until the end gets a prize of 8 and a quarter Doubloons! (25$ USD) To sign up, quickly choose a member of the cast. This will be your assigned person for the first round of the game. Remember not to choose someone already chosen or you may not get in! Arr ya ready? Go! (edited)
